messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: Magic Miner 40T, $799, Batch 6 ships Nov 21, 2026 — cheapest per TH we sell; ask their rate and I'll run the numbers.

Hey, I'm Sarah! At about sixteen cents the Magic Miner 40T costs around $75 a month to run. It's $799, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Looked up for Sarah: They're adding to an existing setup — Magic Miner 40T is our cheapest per TH, $799, Batch 6 ships November 21, 2026; date depends on the manufacturer.
Nice. The 40T's the cheapest per terahash we sell, seven ninety-nine for forty TH. What are you running now?
Looked up for Sarah: 40T is tunable: 30 TH at 450W, 40 at 650W, 50 at 850W in Turbo — $16 per TH, solo to their own node, ~50 dB in Eco.
Then you know the drill. It's forty TH at six-fifty watts, and Batch 6 ships November twenty-first if the manufacturer stays on schedule. Would you point it at your pool or go solo?
Looked up for Sarah: Pool mode pays small and steady to their own wallet, no exchange or KYC; Eco 30 TH at 450W drops power to about $52 a month instead of $75.

Good fit. It pays small Bitcoin straight to your wallet, and around seventy-five a month in power at sixteen cents. Eco mode drops it to thirty TH and about fifty-two a month. Want one? (The call ended. 3 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
